limitations: Silver-vs-advisory comparison: neither side is a human-adjudicated ground truth.
The reference ranking reflects the blind reviews the lexicon cannot judge; the deterministic counts come from the reviews it can. The two sides cover disjoint review subsets.
The deterministic ranking uses the documented experimental rule (opposing + conflicting, tie by matched_count), not the shipped workbench triage ordering.
Only three controlled products are compared per aspect, so each tau rests on at most three item pairs; treat values as directional, not precise.
Model rankings come from one tool-call per aspect at temperature 0 with the config-pinned model (thinking disabled); no sampling variance is measured.
Engineering exploration; not a phase gate and not a business-impact claim.
